summary: Deep adversarial review of the ggml-ABI-matched Q4_K_M kernel + upstream package destined for an external RFC. The engineering core is CLEAN and independently verified: the .axc kernel is line-for-line exactly the six ABI deltas vs the M3.6 leader with no smuggled changes; the emitted SPIR-V confirms every ABI-critical fact (B SSBO f32, D SSBO f32, q u8; all four D stores ColumnMajorKHR layout=1; push block exactly 6 members at offsets 0..20 = 24B, legally within ggml's 68B range; StorageBuffer16BitAccess(4433) correctly dropped; workgroup (32,1,1); f32->f16 converts present); the coopmat_store_col codegen is a clean byte-copy of the row-major emitter with layout const 1, typecheck fail-closes ColMajor+Shared and expression-position use, and no corpus golden regressed (36 compile_shared_examples goldens pass; existing stores default to RowMajor -> identical output); the transpose-cancellation trap is avoided (the oracle tests compare against an UN-transposed oracle at asymmetric shapes M=4096/N=512 and M=64/N=128, which cannot cancel; the f16-exact fixture is genuinely f16-first); the patch applies cleanly against the REAL vendor tree at the pinned SHA (AT-2998 ran, not skipped) with hunks anchored in [4090,4211] + near :8239, all #ifdef-guarded, 13-condition fail-closed guard present; the .spv is git-tracked and the .gitignore negation is correctly ordered. HOWEVER: one mandated acceptance test (AT-2997) is entirely ABSENT, and the external-facing REPRODUCE.md falsely cites it as existing/verified. That is the class of defect this review exists to stop before it ships publicly. I independently confirmed the committed .spv IS currently byte-reproducible, so there is no shipped-binary defect today -- but there is no CI guard against future source/binary drift, and a document going into the upstream RFC asserts a verification that does not exist. NEEDS_REVISION, small and mechanical to fix.

high_findings.title: AT-2997 (mandated) is not implemented, and REPRODUCE.md -- an external RFC deliverable -- falsely cites it as existing and verified
high_findings.detail: Spec section 8 mandates AT-2997: 'The committed upstream/matmul_q4_k_f32_cm1_axiom.spv is spirv-val clean AND byte-reproducible from the pinned source + assignments (regen == committed), in compile_shared_examples.rs (CI)'. No such test exists. Exhaustive grep of crates/ finds no `at_2997`/`AT-2997` test function; the only test that references the committed .spv path is AT-3004 (git-tracked check) in m42a_package_integrity.rs -- it never recompiles the kernel nor compares bytes. AT-2987 compiles the SAME source and runs spirv-val (so the 'spirv-val clean' half is effectively covered by identical bytes), but nothing asserts the ON-DISK committed artifact equals a fresh compile -- the exact guard against shipping a stale binary in the RFC package. Worse: upstream/REPRODUCE.md:58-62 states 'AT-2997 (compile_shared_examples.rs) asserts the committed .spv is byte-reproducible from this exact command' and 'verified in the coder pass (AT-2985/2987/2997)'. Both references are to a nonexistent test, in a document that will be read by a llama.cpp maintainer. For a milestone whose thesis is 'the compiler VERIFIES what is claimed', shipping a deliverable that cites a fabricated verification is a public-credibility defect. NOTE: I independently ran the documented REPRODUCE.md command (cargo run -p axc-driver --bin axc -- compile ... --strategy-value rb_m=2 rb_n=2 tile_k=16 a_block_size=512 b_block_size=512) and `cmp` reports BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed upstream/matmul_q4_k_f32_cm1_axiom.spv (both 11036 bytes) -- so the artifact is correct TODAY; this is a missing-guard + false-doc-claim, not a wrong-binary. Collateral: QA's requirements_covered=21/21 is wrong (AT-2997 is uncovered -> 20/21); QA's baseline_comparison explicitly lists AT-2997 'landing as passed', which is inaccurate.
high_findings.fix: Implement AT-2997 in compile_shared_examples.rs: recompile the ggml kernel with the rb2x2 assignments and assert the produced bytes == std::fs::read(upstream/matmul_q4_k_f32_cm1_axiom.spv) (it will pass -- verified byte-identical), plus a spirv-val on those bytes. This closes the drift guard AND makes the REPRODUCE.md claim true. If for any reason the test is not added, the two REPRODUCE.md references to AT-2997 must be corrected to name the tests that actually run (AT-2987 for compile+spirv-val) and drop the false 'byte-reproducible' assertion -- but implementing the mandated test is the correct resolution.

design_notes_for_architect.title: Host-patch guard condition #8 calls ggml_vk_guess_split_k with the STOCK guess pipeline, not the AXIOM override pipeline that will actually dispatch
design_notes_for_architect.detail: In upstream/ggml-vulkan-axiom-q4k.patch the override branch (at :8239) evaluates condition #8 as `ggml_vk_guess_split_k(ctx, ne01, ne11, ne10, disable_split_k, pipeline) == 1` where `pipeline` is still the STOCK guess result. But the real split-K decision at :8252 will be recomputed with the OVERRIDDEN AXIOM pipeline (wg_denoms {32,32,1}, fixed 32x32 tile). If the AXIOM pipeline geometry yields a different split_k than the stock pipeline at some shape, split-K could activate on AXIOM's single-split kernel (which does not support it). This is latent and the patch is explicitly NOT built/run in M4.2a (out of scope; gated behind the HARD real-ggml smoke precondition, section 7.5) and the not-compiled caveat is disclosed in REPRODUCE.md/patch header. Not an M4.2a blocker, but the Architect should ensure the RFC-trigger real-ggml smoke exercises a split-K-eligible shape so this cannot slip into the eventual upstream build.

verified_clean: Kernel diff is EXACTLY the six ABI deltas vs the M3.6 leader (git diff line-by-line): B->f32, n_blocks_per_row=stride_a/256u32, grid axis swap (block_row=gid(0)/32u32, block_col=gid(1)), B staged transposed+converted (b_global=col*stride_b+row; f32_to_f16(x[...])), D column-major (coopmat_store_col with (tile_col*16)*stride_d+(tile_row*16)). No smuggled changes.

D-store algebra correct: 2x2 accumulator->tile mapping preserved (acc_00->row0/col0 ... acc_11->row1/col1); each base offset is col*stride_d+row (the correct column-major transpose of the leader's row*N+col).

SPIR-V (disassembled by direct binary parse): entry point 'q4km_matmul_rb_coopmat_f32acc_cached_ggml', ExecutionMode LocalSize (32,1,1); binding0=struct{arr<i8>}, binding1(B/x)=struct{arr<f32>}, binding2(C/D)=struct{arr<f32>}; all four OpCooperativeMatrixStoreKHR reference the single layout constant %203 = value 1 (ColumnMajorKHR), no row-major D store remains; push struct %20 has exactly 6 members at offsets 0,4,8,12,16,20 (24B, subset of ggml's 68B range -> vkCmdPushConstants-legal); capability set excludes StorageBuffer16BitAccess(4433) (correct drop from B-retype) and retains Float16(9)/Int16(22)/CooperativeMatrixKHR(6022)/StorageBuffer8BitAccess(4448 for u8 q); two f32->f16 OpFConvert sites present (B staging + dequant narrow).

coopmat_store_col codegen: emit_coopmat_store_col_inline is a faithful byte-copy of emit_coopmat_store_inline with COL_MAJOR_LAYOUT=1; body.rs dispatches on the layout discriminant; the Shared path fail-closes on ColMajor; typecheck rejects coopmat_store_col at expression position and coopmat_store_col targeting a shared array.

No corpus regression: existing coopmat_store call sites default to CoopMatStoreLayout::RowMajor -> unchanged emitter -> identical SPIR-V; 36 compile_shared_examples goldens + 319 axc-hir lib tests pass.

Static ABI goldens bind to REAL artifacts, not vacuously: AT-3000 (B f32) and AT-2995 (6 scalars @0-20, bindings q/x/C=0/1/2) assert against compiled meta.binding_plan; AT-3001/AT-3003/AT-2988 assert against kernel source text; AT-3005 cross-checks block_q4_K=144 against the oracle's Q4KM_SUPERBLOCK_BYTES. The circularity that hid r1's #1/#2 cannot recur.

Transpose-cancellation trap avoided: dispatch_q4km_ggml.rs compares the de-transposed GPU output against the UN-transposed logical oracle at asymmetric AT-3002 (M=4096,N=512) and AT-2990 (M=64,N=128) -- a kernel axis-swap or column-major-store bug cannot cancel against the oracle. AT-2986 uses a deliberately NON-symmetric 16x16 tile fixture. The f16-exact fixture is genuinely f16-first (make_x_f16 -> transpose_widen_b exact widen).

Patch verified against the REAL vendor tree: vendor/llama.cpp present at pinned SHA 6b80c74f28; AT-2998 actually executed (not typed-skipped) -- git apply --check exit 0, hunks anchor in [4090,4211] (creation) and window [8200,8242] (override), all hunks #ifdef GGML_VULKAN_AXIOM_Q4K, 13-condition fail-closed guard present.
